{{Quote|You probably noticed, but we're trying to get a lot of people out from under the tail of Yusinduu&mdash;our esteemed employer.|Adi Vonapa to the Alliance Commander|<ref name="ThePathBelow" />}}
This '''rebellion''' was a movement led by the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Adi Vonapa]] and the [[Evocii]] [[Rakit]]. The latter opposed the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Vobbara Yusinduu]] who settled in the [[Minboosa District]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] to establish his illegal business.<ref name="OutOfTheMire" />
